description: An introductory squat pattern using a chair for depth guidance and confidence while teaching proper hip hinge mechanics.
setup: Stand a few inches in front of a standard stable chair with feet hip-width apart and toes pointing straight or slightly turned out.
steps: Reach arms out in front for counterbalance and initiate movement by reaching hips back.
Lower down until buttocks lightly graze the chair seat without resting your full bodyweight.
Drive through feet and stand straight up, squeezing glutes at the top.
cues: Sit back into your hips rather than sliding knees forward
Keep chest upright and eyes forward

mistakes.mistake: Collapsing into the chair and relaxing core muscles
mistakes.fix: Touch chair seat feather-lightly and reverse direction immediately

mistakes.mistake: Shifting weight solely onto toes during ascent
mistakes.fix: Keep heels pinned firmly to the ground and push through whole foot

rep_standard: Glutes touch chair seat lightly without sitting down, standing to full upright extension
